newsitem.title: UK: LucasVarity buys California components firm.
newsitem.headline: LucasVarity buys California components firm.

text.p: Anglo-U.S. systems manufacturer LucasVarity said on Friday it had bought S.B.C Ltd and Kinetic Parts Manufacturing, known as Autospeciality, but that terms of the deal would not be disclosed.

Autospeciality is a privately-owned manufacturer and distributor of "replacement undercar components" based in California and with projected 1996 sales of over 40 million stg, LucasVarity said in a statement.
"The Autospeciality acquisition provides the platform for LucasVarity's strategic expansion in the North American independent aftermarket," it added.
